setup_logging_config: setup centralized logging for Hermes Agent with rotating file handlers, redaction, and component separation
setup_verbose_logging: enable DEBUG-level console logging for verbose mode with timestamp and session context tags
set_session_context: set the session ID for the current thread so all log records include the session tag for correlation
clear_session_context: clear the session ID for the current thread to stop including session tags in log records
read_logging_config: read logging configuration from config.yaml including level, max size, and backup count settings
